verdict.rationale: Entra documents Lifecycle Workflows that automatically run processes against users across the three phases of their lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver). It also documents automatic provisioning of Entra users into SaaS and on-premises apps, which covers the directory-to-app half of the story. The pack has no evidence of inbound HR-driven provisioning that makes the HRIS the source of truth creating and updating directory users. missing for 10: documented HRIS inbound provisioning (HR system as source of truth), evidence that HR attribute changes trigger mover/leaver updates to app assignments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: Lifecycle workflows (LCW) are identity governance capabilities that enable organizations to manage Microsoft Entra users across the three phases of a user's lifecycle with an organization
Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
Common scenarios include provisioning a Microsoft Entra user into SaaS applications like Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and many more.
